# Canvas Game Idea: "Pixel Patrol"

- **Genre:** Arcade shooter
- **Core Loop:** Player controls a ship at the bottom of the canvas, moving left/right and firing upward at descending alien blocks.
- **Mechanics:** Aliens descend in waves; each alien that reaches the bottom adds one damage point.
- **Lose Condition:** The game ends when the player accumulates three damage points (or when the ship is hit).
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible; score based on aliens destroyed.
- **Tech:** Simple shapes (rectangles, circles) drawn on an HTML5 `<canvas>`; keyboard controls; `requestAnimationFrame` loop.

1: // Simple "Pixel Patrol" canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is assumed to exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id="game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'square';
15:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
20:   }
21:   function playShoot() { playTone(440, 80); }
22:   function playExplosion() { playTone(200, 150); }
23:   function playGameOver() { playTone(100, 300); }
24:   // Create starfield background
25:   const starCount = 100;
26:   const stars = [];
27:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
28:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
29:   }
30:   const width = canvas.width;
31:   const height = canvas.height;
32: 
33:   // Game state
34:   const ship = { w: 30, h: 10, x: width / 2 - 15, y: height - 20, speed: 4 };
35:   const bullets = [];
36:   const aliens = [];
37:   let score = 0;
38:   let damage = 0;
39:   const maxDamage = 3;
40:   let lastAlienSpawn = 0;
41:   const alienSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
42:   const alienSpeed = 0.5;
43:   const bulletSpeed = 5;
44: 
45:   // Input handling
46:   const keys = {};
47:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
48:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
49: 
50:   function spawnAliens() {
51:     const cols = 8;
52:     const rows = 2;
53:     const alienW = 20;
54:     const alienH = 15;
55:     const padding = 5;
56:     const offsetX = (width - (cols * (alienW + padding))) / 2;
57:     for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
58:       for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
59:         aliens.push({
60:           x: offsetX + c * (alienW + padding),
61:           y: r * (alienH + padding),
62:           w: alienW,
63:           h: alienH,
64:         });
65:       }
66:     }
67:   }
68: 
69:   function update(dt) {
70:   // Update stars (slow drift)
71:   stars.forEach(s => { s.y += 0.2; if (s.y > height) s.y = 0; });
72:     // Ship movement
73:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && ship.x > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
74:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] && ship.x + ship.w < width) ship.x += ship.speed;
75:     // Shooting
76:     if (keys[' '] && !keys['_spacePressed']) {
77:       bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2, y: ship.y, w: 2, h: 8 });
78:       playShoot();
79:       keys['_spacePressed'] = true;
80:     }
81:     if (!keys[' ']) keys['_spacePressed'] = false;
82: 
83:     // Update bullets
84:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
85:       const b = bullets[i];
86:       b.y -= bulletSpeed;
87:       if (b.y + b.h < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
88:     }
89: 
90:     // Spawn aliens periodically
91:     if (performance.now() - lastAlienSpawn > alienSpawnInterval) {
92:       spawnAliens();
93:       lastAlienSpawn = performance.now();
94:     }
95: 
96:     // Update aliens
97:     for (let i = aliens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
98:       const a = aliens[i];
99:       a.y += alienSpeed;
100:       // Check if alien reached bottom
101:       if (a.y + a.h >= height) {
102:         aliens.splice(i, 1);
103:         damage++;
104:         if (damage >= maxDamage) {
105:           gameOver();
106:           return;
107:         }
108:       }
109:     }
110: 
111:     // Collision detection bullet‑alien
112:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
113:       const b = bullets[i];
114:       for (let j = aliens.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
115:         const a = aliens[j];
116:         if (
117:           b.x < a.x + a.w &&
118:           b.x + b.w > a.x &&
119:           b.y < a.y + a.h &&
120:           b.y + b.h > a.y
121:         ) {
122:           bullets.splice(i, 1);
123:           aliens.splice(j, 1);
124:           score++;
125:           playExplosion();
126:           break;
127:         }
128:       }
129:     }
130:   }
131: 
132:   function draw() {
133:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
134:     // Ship (triangle)
135:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
136:     ctx.beginPath();
137:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
138:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
139:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
140:     ctx.closePath();
141:     ctx.fill();
142:     // Bullets (glow circles)
143:     bullets.forEach(b => {
144:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, 0, b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, b.w);
145:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.8)');
146:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
147:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
148:       ctx.beginPath();
149:       ctx.arc(b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, b.w, 0, Math.PI*2);
150:       ctx.fill();
151:     });
152:     // Aliens (glow circles)
153:     aliens.forEach(a => {
154:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, 0, a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w);
155:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,0,0,0.9)');
156:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,0,0,0)');
157:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
158:       ctx.beginPath();
159:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w, 0, Math.PI*2);
160:       ctx.fill();
161:     });
162:     // UI
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
164:     ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
165:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 15);
166:     ctx.fillText(`Damage: ${damage}/${maxDamage}`, 10, 30);
167:   }
168: 
169:   let lastTime = 0;
170:   function loop(timestamp) {
171:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
172:     lastTime = timestamp;
173:     update(dt);
174:     draw();
175:     if (damage < maxDamage) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
176:   }
177: 
178:   function gameOver() { playGameOver();
179:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
180:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
181:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
182:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
183:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
184:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 10);
185:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
186:   }
187: 
188:   // Start loop
189:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
190: })();

(End of file - total 190 lines)
</content>
